page.layout: One page of text, centred; a dedication block with title lines, then a closing line with initials and a Greek word at the foot right.

main_text.head: Pietate, Doctrinâ, Genere, Usuq; rerum, spectatissimo Viro,
main_text.p: D. BERNHARDO BRANDO, inclytæ Reipublicæ Basileensis in Dynastiâ Waldeburgensi Præfecto gravissimo; Domino Affini, Patrono, & Amico multis modis honoratissimo,
cùm in Virtutis ipsius meritam prædicationem; cùm in observantiæ suæ & affectus debiti testificationem,

page.notes: The Greek word at the foot is printed as "ΑΕΪΝΑ" with a dot before it; read as ΑΕΐΝΑ. Some lines are partly obscured by an ink stain at "cùm in observantiæ"; the words "observantiæ suæ" are read from the surviving letters and are uncertain. The line "Pietate" is printed in italic with a swash on the initial letter. Ornamental stains show across the centre of the page; no page number, running head or signature is printed.
